I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM that it's ready. It hasn't been sent; someone has to send it from the drafts.

- Subject: "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: the $2,101 per-seat rate Marcus gave, and a note that Anselm approved sharing it. It's signed as Anselm.

No other approval was needed. Anselm is the CFO, so his OK covers sharing a finance figure with Hollis. Hollis is at pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval for outside mail doesn't apply.

I didn't check the $2,101 figure against Marcus's own message or any account records. It comes from Anselm's message only.
